title: PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS: Free client website with text-to-image, text-to-video, and text-to-voiceover tools

requirements.text: Create a client-facing website for “PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS” that is 100% free to use and clearly presents the available AI-based tools: Text-to-Image, Text-to-Video, Text-to-Voiceover, and a placeholder area for additional future tools.

quotes: And now i want to make a 100% free website where my clients wil able to make Text to video/ text to image/ text to voiceover and more ai based services.

acceptanceCriteria: A landing/home page exists with PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS branding and a clear list of tools.
All user-facing text is in English.
The UI indicates the site is free (no pricing/paywall UI).
Navigation lets users access each tool from the home page.

requirements.text: Add a Text-to-Image tool page that accepts a text prompt and produces a generated image result entirely on the client (no external AI/LLM service dependency), with options to download the output image.

quotes: make Text to video/ text to image/ text to voiceover

acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a prompt and click Generate to produce an image preview.
User can download the generated image as a file.
Generation works without calling any third-party AI provider APIs.

requirements.text: Add a Text-to-Voiceover tool page that accepts text input and produces voiceover audio using a client-side approach (e.g., browser speech synthesis), with basic controls (play/pause/stop) and an option to download/export audio when feasible in-browser.
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter text and trigger voice playback.
User can stop playback and re-run with edited text.
No third-party AI provider APIs are used.

requirements.text: Add a Text-to-Video tool page that accepts a text prompt and produces a simple generated video result entirely on the client (e.g., animated text/scene rendered in-browser and recorded), with a preview and a download option.
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a prompt and click Generate to produce a playable video preview.
User can download the generated video file.
Generation works without calling any third-party AI provider APIs.

requirements.text: Add basic user accounts using Internet Identity so clients can sign in and see their own generation history (prompts and resulting downloadable assets metadata) across sessions.

quotes: create a website for my clients

acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in/out with Internet Identity.
After sign-in, generated items are associated to the signed-in principal.
A “My History” section lists prior generations with timestamp and type (image/video/voiceover) and allows re-opening an item.

requirements.text: Implement backend persistence in the single Motoko actor to store per-user generation records (type, prompt/text, createdAt, and references/identifiers needed by the frontend).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes methods to create and list a user’s generation records.
Records are isolated per authenticated principal.
Data survives canister upgrades using stable storage patterns (no migration file unless required by implementation).

requirements.text: Provide a cohesive, distinct visual theme for the site (colors, typography, spacing, component styling) and apply it consistently across the landing page and all tool pages. Avoid default-looking UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme is consistent across pages (buttons, inputs, cards, headings).
Theme does not rely on blue/purple as the primary palette unless explicitly necessary.
UI is responsive and usable on mobile and desktop.

requirements.text: Add generated static brand assets (logo + hero illustration + tool icons) to the frontend and use them in the UI from the static assets folder (do not fetch images from the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend.
Home page displays the logo and hero illustration.
Each tool entry has a simple icon.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in the main actor).

Do not modify files under frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose these components instead).
Do not use third-party AI/LLM providers or integrations (e.g., OpenAI/Anthropic). Tools must work without external AI services.
nonGoals: Paid plans, billing, subscriptions, or payment processing.
Third-party authentication providers other than Internet Identity.
Using external databases or non-Motoko backend services.

required: PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS logo, clean modern mark with digital/creative feel (pnd-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Website hero illustration with abstract digital creative tools motif, modern and minimal (pnd-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
Set of three simple monochrome icons: image, video, microphone/voice (pnd-tool-icons.dim_256x256.png)

goalsToAdd: Build a free client-facing PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS website with in-browser text-to-image, text-to-video, and text-to-voiceover tools.
preferencesToAdd: Use English for all user-facing UI text.
